verses.english: “Mendicants, there are these five powers of a lady.
Attractiveness, wealth, relatives, children, and ethical behavior.

verses.pali: Na, bhikkhave, mātugāmo rūpabalahetu vā bhogabalahetu vā ñātibalahetu vā puttabalahetu vā kāyassa bhedā paraṁ maraṇā sugatiṁ saggaṁ lokaṁ upapajjati.
verses.english: It is not because of the powers of attractiveness, wealth, relatives, or children that ladies, when their body breaks up, after death, are reborn in a good place, a heavenly realm.

verses.pali: Sīlabalahetu kho, bhikkhave, mātugāmo kāyassa bhedā paraṁ maraṇā sugatiṁ saggaṁ lokaṁ upapajjati.
verses.english: It is because of the power of ethical behavior that ladies, when their body breaks up, after death, are reborn in a good place, a heavenly realm.

verses.pali: Imāni kho, bhikkhave, pañca mātugāmassa balānī”ti.
verses.english: These are the five powers of a lady.”
